cs.content: Účast na cvičeních je povinná, k získání zápočtu z entomologické a fytopatologické části je nutné napsat test na 75 %. Zkouška se koná ze dvou částí, entomologické a ústní fytopatologické. Ve fytopatologické části je nutné zodpovědět 3 otázky min. na 50 %.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Knowledge: theoretical knowledge on the origin of disorders, injuries and diseases on the development and spread of pathogens and pests skills: the ability to determine causes of defects and damage, significant agents of the diseases and pests of vegetables and fruit trees, and propose options for protection of plants To obtain the ability to detect of pathogens and insect pests, and to recommend appropriate means of protection against them.

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: In order to obtain compensation, participation in compulsory exercises. Credit in the form of microscopic slides of cognitive test of pathogens (75%) and pests (75%). Exam in the form of the test consists of entomological (50%) and the phytopathological part (50%). To obtain the credits is required at least 75% of correct answers in each test.
